$comment: Identifier prefixes nobody may be allocated. A reserved namespace and a private one are the same shape — org.iso.18013.5.1 and th.co.codefin are both reverse-DNS — so nothing about the string stops somebody taking org.iso.18013.5.2 and looking official. This list does, at the moment an identifier is handed out, rather than after an argument.
$comment_names: Registered JWT and SD-JWT VC claim names. A credential attribute may not be called one of these: it would sit beside the signature's own fields, indistinguishable to a reader, or overwrite one of them on the way out.
